title: Fogok Hívni: The Future Tense with fog

sections.title: A one-word "will"
sections.content: You already know one way to talk about the future: present tense plus a future time word, like Jövőre folyékonyan beszélek magyarul. Hungarian also has a dedicated future tense: fog (a completely regular verb) plus an infinitive. fogok hívni means "I will call" — a more explicit statement of what will definitely happen, often a promise or a plan someone else is counting on.

items.english: Tomorrow I will call the doctor.

sections.content: fog itself never changes what the sentence means, person to person — it just marks the future, exactly like kell + infinitive or lehet + infinitive work. The real verb always stays a bare infinitive right after it.
